The data for each site is obtained by means of two individual floating LiDAR systems and one spare to measure wind, waves, currents and ecological properties. The systems must be minimum in commercial stage 2 and preferably in commercial stage 3 of the OWA Roadmap for commercial acceptance of floating LiDAR technologies (or equal).
